logp.method_description: Lipophilicity (log Po/w) of CCP was determined using a water-octanol system by conventional shake flask method as described in the literature.[32] Here log Po/w is defined as the logarithmic ratio of concentration of CCP concentration in n-octanol to that in water phase. For this, 0.5 mg of CCP were taken separately in 3 mL of a 1:1 mixture of n-octanol and water and mixed vigorously for 24 h. The mixture was kept for another 24 h, after which both layers were separated. The concentration of CCP was then determined by UV spectroscopy in both the octanol and water phases. The following equation was used to determine the Partition coefficient log P [logP = log(Aoct/Awater)]. where Aoct stands for the absorbance of complex in octanol phase, and Awater stands for the absorption of complex in water phase. (Figure S21, Supporting Information).
